## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 44 user-facing changes.
### New
- Keep videos visible in native Picture in Picture when switching Mac tabs, with an option to turn automatic entry off - Let permitted extensions read clipboard text, including grade-transfer tools that use legacy paste
### Improved
- Keep the Mac Space picker centered as it fills up, with arrows to reveal more Spaces - Show the split preview just beyond the sidebar and update its landing position as you drag across the page - Show Start Page when entering a Mac Space with an unloaded tab, keeping the page unloaded until you select it
### Fixed
- Keep website styling extensions from changing other extensions’ sidebars - Support extensions such as SponsorBlock that use relative background-worker paths - Recover synced open-tab folders after updating Crest and handle unsupported folder records on older versions - Give Quick Window pages an even border below the address bar and around the sides and bottom - Keep saved and pinned tabs in place when adding copies to a split view, with independent page history - Start fresh mobile sessions on the sidebar or start page without automatically selecting a saved tab or split view - Open extension panels reliably after idle and dismiss popups when clicking their toolbar icon again
---
Nightly builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
Showing the 12 most recent highlights from 56 user-facing changes.
### New
- Use custom search engines with website icons and optional search suggestions in each Space - See update availability and control media from a global sidebar widget deck across Spaces
### Improved
- Follow new downloads into Downloads and see live size, progress, speed, and time remaining across Mac and iPhone
### Fixed
- Show blocked pop-ups in Site Controls with a one-step allow action - Keep loading pages on-brand, reuse an open Start Page, and search tabs only in the current Space - Keep Space navigation centered and Archive controls reachable as more Spaces are added - Continue typing with the same caret or selection after returning to a webpage tab on Mac - Use compatible browser extension actions directly from webpage context menus - Keep mouse back and forward navigation within the webpage or sidebar under the pointer - Keep new-window links inside Peek and Quick Window instead of hiding them in background tabs - Start loading tabs opened from links right away, with an option to select them automatically - Refresh available updates to the newest eligible build before downloading
---
Stable releases are signed, notarized, and ready for everyday use.
